description.value: Analog Coffee is a specialty coffee chain founded in Calgary in 2011 with a strong emphasis on sourcing and carefully crafting single-origin coffees. The brand built its identity around an obsessive attention to every detail of the guest experience, from equipment to décor. A touring cyclist stopping in can expect a serious, community-oriented café with a full espresso program and a range of brewing methods.
